violation_type.title: Director Responsibilities - Submit and Follow Written Plan of Responsibilities (26 TAC §744.1005(b))
violation_type.short_title: Director Responsibilities - Submit and Follow Written Plan of Responsibilities
violation_type.typical_finding: A plan for assignment of responsibilities was not available for review.

finding_variants.text: A plan for assignment of responsibilities was not available for review.

At the time of the inspection it was found that the previously established responsibilities for the program director are not being followed by the program director assigned to the site. The staff at the site stated a different person was their program director.
